[SWS_PHM_01338] Avoid redundant Monitoring of Termination for Self- Terminating Process
⌈
If an Alive Supervision is configured for a Self Terminat-
ing Process and if after reporting of terminatingCheckpoint and before termi-
natingCheckpointTimeoutUntilTermination is elapsed Platform Health
Management receives the information from Execution Management that the process
will be notified to terminate via SIGTERM, then Platform Health Management
shall stop monitoring the timeout.
⌋
